title: Wire up the Most Frequent Duplicates report section
target_unit: addDuplicationToReport() in DuplicationReportGenerator (file of 425 LOC, below the threshold) and exportSourceFile() in DataExporter (file of 813 LOC, high risk)
notes: The real change is +6/-1: addDuplicationToReport() calls the existing but unused addMostFrequentDuplicatesList() after the longest duplicates (with stopwatch lines; the commit also makes that method package-private for its own test), and exportSourceFile() saves the most_frequent_duplicates fragment files. The real diff applies to the snapshot as is. The acceptance test (3 cases) renders the duplication report through the public addDuplicationToReport() and runs DataExporter.saveData() on a synthetic analysis into a @TempDir. A before: compiles, 2 of 3 fail with assertion failures (no section; no most_frequent_duplicates_1.java). A after (reference diff applied): 3/3 pass, and mvn -o -pl reports -am test is green (353 tests in the reactor, 0 failures).
